question: As for the year 2020-21, which of the following states had the lowest unemployment rate among persons aged 15 years and above?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Madhya Pradesh had the lowest unemployment rate among people aged 15 years and above in 2020-21.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
Gujarat: The unemployment rate in Gujarat for the year 2020-21 was 3.1%.

 
 
• 
 
Jharkhand: In 2020-21, Jharkhand had an unemployment rate of 3.6%.

 
 
• 
 
Delhi: The unemployment rate in Delhi during 2020-21 stood at 4.6%.

 
 
• 
 
Chhattisgarh: Chhattisgarh has the lowest unemployment rate in India, with 14 unemployed individuals per 1,000 people.

 
 
• 
 
Youth Unemployment: The unemployment rate among youth aged 15-29 was 12.9% in 2020-21.
